title: Affordable Generative Agents
abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has significantly advanced the simulation of believable interactive agents. However, the substantial cost of prolonged agent interactions remains a challenge. This paper proposes Affordable Generative Agents, a framework that reduces agent-environment and inter-agent interaction costs while preserving believable behavior through learned policies and social memory.
